skins.name: Gwiazdcytrony
skins.description: Meteor's winter clothes from back in Kazimierz. Balancing lightness and warmth, they also allow one to easily hide in dense forests. A reproduction.

skins.name: Ignis Fatuus
skins.description: A gift for Lessing from some young Liches , for taking the brunt of their teacher 's ire. Though it's the opposite of his usual style, he looks surprisingly cool in it.

skins.name: Wingbreaker
skins.description: Texas the Omertosa's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The hunter shot down the great demon Vermithrax, but was betrayed by the Lone Wolf Emperor and banished to the barrens.

skins.name: Lances of Kaliskas
skins.code: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Lances of Kaliskas
skins.description: Ashlock's formalwear, worn when her family banished her. Traditional dress worthy of a Kazimierz knight, not entirely inappropriate on her.

skins.name: Noon Twilight
skins.description: Absinthe's former school uniform. In Ursus , students wear their uniforms while exercising, resembling a field of neatly spaced seedlings behind a plow.

skins.name: Royal Guardswoman
skins.description: Bagpipe's uniform as a new cadet at the military academy, doubling as formal wear. Training in formal wear was yet another duty of a royal guardsman cadet.

skins.name: W Dali
skins.description: Młynar's attire as a knight-errant, wandering Kazimierz's plains and endless forests, the words engraved on the hilt of his sword not yet covered by useless trinkets.
